- Total revenue across all countries reached £103,744.81 TW, representing a decline of 12.1% WoW from £117,975.95 LW.

- Total revenue increased 23.4% YoY, demonstrating strong year-over-year growth despite the weekly decline.

- United Kingdom maintained rank 1 with revenue of £89,759.37 TW, accounting for 86.5% of total revenue TW, but declined 15.9% WoW.

- Japan achieved the largest WoW increase with revenue change of +12485.6% WoW, growing from £45.57 LW to £5,735.24 TW and reaching rank 2.

- Germany held rank 3 with revenue of £2,840.80 TW representing 2.7% of total revenue TW, declining 27.0% WoW.

- United Kingdom showed the largest YoY increase with revenue change of +20.5% YoY, growing from £74,480.20 LY to £89,759.37 TW.

- France experienced the largest WoW decrease with revenue change of -85.1% WoW, falling from £5,710.94 LW to £852.44 TW.

- France recorded the largest YoY decrease with revenue change of -82.3% YoY, declining from £4,804.52 LY to £852.44 TW.
